messages:
sec-bot: ALERT: High-volume data export detected from redshift.prod by service_account-exporter (87 concurrent COPY/UNLOAD ops in 5m). Potential data exfil. <https://siem.internal/alerts/1802587650|view alert>
amanda: seeing this now — is this a scheduled reporting job?
raj: not one I'm aware of. last scheduled unloads are at 03:00 UTC, this is 14:12 UTC.
sasha: grabbing query ids and users. running: `select query, userid, starttime, substring(trim(querytxt),1,200) from stl_query where querytxt ilike '%unload%' and starttime > '2026-03-19 14:00:00';`
raj: snippet from stl_query: `query=834912, user_name=service_account-exporter, starttime=2026-03-19 14:11:03, querytxt=UNLOAD ('select * from analytics.public.events') to 's3://redwood-exports/2026/03/19/';`
lena: which KMS key was used for the S3 target? can we confirm if SSE-KMS was applied or S3-managed?
tom: logs show `x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256` for the PUTs — so S3-managed (SSE-S3). not KMS.
maria: that increases risk — unencrypted with our KMS policy.
amanda: containment step 1: disable the service_account-exporter role immediately and revoke its temporary creds. @infra-bot can you action? :lock:
infra-bot: `aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name service_account-exporter --policy-document '{}'` -> role temporarily disabled. Confirmed at 2026-03-19T14:15:07Z. :white_check_mark:
sasha: running revoke of active sessions and revoking STS tokens for that role now.
raj: can we identify all destinations for the export? which S3 bucket/object prefixes were written?
sasha: s3 access logs show writes to `s3://redwood-exports/2026/03/19/` and `s3://shared-exports/tmp/` from the same IAM key. listing objects... there are ~92 objects, ~18GB compressed.
lena: check CloudTrail KMS: no kms:Encrypt calls for that key during timeframe. confirms SSE-S3.
maria: team — do we have evidence this was malicious vs. misconfiguration (old job pointed to production)? any deploy/infra change around 14:10?
tom: deploy history: none at 14:00-14:20. There was a config change in infra repo yesterday adding a new export helper, but no rollout this morning.
amanda: next steps: 1) isolate exports (done), 2) snapshot current buckets/objects -> take immutable copies to our forensics bucket, 3) preserve DB and Redshift audit logs, 4) open incident ticket and notify legal.
raj: snapshot commands: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-exports/2026/03/19/ s3://forensics/redwood-exports/2026-03-19/ --recursive --storage-class STANDARD_IA` (running now). Also exported Redshift query logs to secure bucket.
sasha: added a DB-level audit row to note this incident: `insert into security.audit_events (...) values ('export_spike', 'service_account-exporter', now(), 'detected');`
lena: recommend rotating the KMS key policy to deny PutObject without kms:Encrypt if a KMS key isn't used. Also propose mandating SSE-KMS for all exports.
maria: filing internal compliance notif to Legal with initial summary and expected data volume. tagging @legal.
amanda: quick mitigation item to follow up in next 24h: add an RBAC rule preventing service accounts from calling UNLOAD/EXPORT unless explicitly allowed. Schedule a policy PR.
tom: I'll draft the PR to tighten Redshift role permissions and add an IAM condition on `s3:PutObject` requiring `aws:RequestTag/ExportJob=true`.
raj: also adding an alert rule to detect >10 concurrent UNLOAD/COPY operations per account per 5m.
sasha: forensics: pulling a sample object and checking headers+md5 to see origin. initial check shows objects created by Redshift UNLOAD.
lena: post-incident actions: update runbook to include KMS checks, add automated enforcement in terraform for SSE-KMS on export buckets, and a unit test in infra repo.
amanda: raising follow-up ticket INFRA-2342 for RBAC + KMS enforcement, and SECCOMM-112 for legal/comms. I'll own postmortem.
maria: initial notif sent to stakeholders: legal, product security, customer-safety. No customer PII confirmed yet, continuing scope.
infra-bot: Network policy: blocked outbound S3 access for disabled role at 2026-03-19T14:16:12Z.
amanda: thanks all — we have containment and preservation. please add any additional findings to the incident ticket. We'll meet 16:00 UTC for quick postmortem. :calendar:
raj: uploading query dump and related logs to the incident artifacts in Confluence.
sasha: FYI — found a cron in old repo referencing `redshift-unload.sh` with a hardcoded target bucket. pushing fix to remove and will add CI enforcement.
lena: I'll write the KMS-enforcement terraform change and open a PR.
tom: PR for RBAC changes in draft, will link to INFRA-2342.
maria: legal requested estimated rows/columns exported. Sasha can you provide anonymized schema/row counts?
sasha: sample indicates ~18M rows, primary columns: event_id, user_id (hashed), event_type, payload_meta. will redact user_id values before sharing.
amanda: closing interim thread — please keep updates in the incident ticket. We'll publish a short incident note after the 16:00 UTC postmortem. :lock:
